assertions.name: ac-judgeable-by-everyone
rubric: Every acceptance criterion names something a person sees or does in the CRM (for example 'A new case for an account whose service manager is active appears in that service manager's case list'), so the client's Customer Success lead could check it in UAT without reading code. Fail: any criterion about a field API name, the flow, a test class, code coverage or the deployment path.

The criteria cover all three behaviours: the named active service manager gets the case; an account with no service manager or an inactive one sends the case to the CS triage queue; Partner Portal cases keep landing in the partner team's queue.
The flow design, field API names, test class and deployment path are kept for the engineer in the description (or a technical notes section), not dropped.
